comment: Configuração global de IA (singleton id=1). Owner-only. Chaves de API NÃO vivem aqui (Vault).
Append-only. Uma linha por chamada real ao LLM. INSERT só pelo service_role (Edge ai-generate).
Internal attendant notes pinned to a conversation. Store-scoped, internal-only (never sent to the customer). mentions[] fans out to in-app notifications via trigger.
Last whatsapp-avatar-sync attempt for this contact; NULL = never attempted (idempotency).
Public URL of the contact's WhatsApp profile photo (avatars bucket); NULL = none/private.

Contact's most recent WhatsApp profile name (pushName), persisted by the webhook on every inbound message — independent of the editable display name (full_name / nome_fantasia). Lets the platform show and restore the WhatsApp name after a manual rename.
PRD-118: WhatsApp number validity. invalid = Meta 131026 seen; manual revalidation only.
PRD-211: departments (revived ITeam). Store-scoped grouping of sellers with an optional manager. Membership is derived from sellers.department_id (no member column here).
Outbound WhatsApp provider call audit (PRD-112 RF-120). Written by Edge Functions (service_role) only; owner-only read.
HSM template catalog (PRD-116). Mirrors Meta Business Manager approvals; manual sync in MVP.
PRD-118: provider error code of a failed dispatch/status (e.g. '131026').
Inbound media fetch outcome (PRD-114): ok = stored in whatsapp-media bucket; failed = URL expired/timeout, manual retry.
Canonical provider message id (Meta wamid / Evolution key.id) — PRD-114.
Webhook idempotency ledger (PRD-114). event_key = whatsapp:<provider>:<providerMessageId>. service_role only.
Maps auth.users to app role/store/seller (PRD-107). Source for JWT custom claims.
RBAC resource catalog (PRD-211). One row per protectable resource; mirrors RESOURCES.
RBAC permissions per role (PRD-211). One row per (role, resource); mirrors PERMISSIONS_MATRIX.
RBAC roles (PRD-211). System roles use id = slug and store_id = null; custom roles are store-scoped.
PRD-213: queue participants. scope_department_id null = top-level; set = internal member of that department. last_assigned_member_id is the per-department internal pointer (on the department row).
PRD-213: attendance rotation queue, one per store. targetMode direct|department; last_assigned_ref_id is the fairness pointer.
When the server worker last claimed this row for dispatch. NULL = unclaimed. Dedups concurrent ticks; a row stuck >5min (crash) is re-claimable.
Sales team (staff/external/representative). Maps to ISeller (people.ts). PRD-101.
Gestor seller for the store (recipient of manager-targeted derived notifications). Nullable.
Stores/units of the platform. Maps to IStore (src/shared/types/platform.ts). POC for Fase 2.
Health state maintained by whatsapp_health_tick + manual owner action (PRD-120).
Backup account for NEW outbound while primary is down/paused (PRD-120). History never migrates.
Non-secret engine config (PRD-111). meta: phoneNumberId/businessAccountId; evolution: baseUrl/instanceName. Secrets live in Edge Function secrets, named by credentials_ref.
Multi-instância: onde a instância aparece — atendimento (caixa), campanha (disparo) ou ambos.
